programme.desc: S01 E02 Auction of Promises Julia finds herself heavily involved in a school fundraiser, hoping to impress a former colleague and new mom crush; Kevin has a battle with the cloakroom and Liz takes care of the bar.

(Mixed martial arts)

The operation spawns the birth of the Medellín cartel and almost brings down the Reagan White House. - Tom Cruise, Domhnall Gleeson, Sarah Wright Olsen, Jesse Plemons, Caleb Landry Jones (Comedy drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. - Emma Roberts, Dave Franco, Juliette Lewis, Emily Meade, Miles Heizer (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama)

programme.title: Inconceivable
programme.desc: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. - Gina Gershon, Faye Dunaway, Nicolas Cage, Nicky Whelan, Natalie Eva Marie (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Deadliest Catch - Stack Fire
programme.desc: S22E3 - After joining forces, Sig and Jake set their boats on a collision course; crew tensions explode on the Time Bandit, leading Keith to lure Freddy back to the Wizard; when the Aleutian Lady's exhaust stack bursts into flames, Rick must fight fire with fire. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure)

programme.title: Deadliest Catch - Hunger Game
programme.desc: S22E4 - When the Time Bandit's freezer fails, John makes an emergency trip to St. George Island to feed his hungry crew. Sig and Jake lure crab to their own side of a maritime boundary. Rick battles a perplexing engine issue amid the biggest waves of the season. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure)

programme.title: Deadliest Catch - Saltwater Runs Deep
programme.desc: S22E5 - A dream leads John to a crab hotspot, but a rival trawler shares the vision for filling its own massive nets. Keith's crew races to save the Wizard as seawater breaches the engine room. On the Northwestern, an erratic crane drags Clark across the deck. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure)

programme.title: Deadliest Catch - Rocked to the Core
programme.desc: S22E6 - When a rogue wave pummels the Wizard and sidelines its crew, Keith reconsiders the risks he's taking; racing to make an offload, Sig loses a deckhand to a crushed toe; Rick finds crab but needs new tactics to fish a seafloor bristling with old crab pots. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure)

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen - Razor's Edge
programme.desc: S3E2 - Jared and his crew attempt to reopen the main logging road at Kachelot Creek by hastily constructing a bridge in the woods; with production stalled and time slipping away, the risky build could get logs moving or derail their shot at the Forever Claim. (Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen - Abandon Ship
programme.desc: S3E3 - Jared sends Adrian and Leon into rough seas to recover a battered tugboat that could change their season; but the return trip becomes a punishing gauntlet of heavy water, engine failures, and near-disasters that could leave them stranded far from camp. (Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen - Blowout
programme.desc: S3E4 - Before the first payday at Kachelot Creek, Alicia's Fat Truck suffers two massive blowouts, blocking the road and halting production; the first barge is closing in, and Ross and crew must find a way to clear the wreck or watch Jared's dream slip away. (Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen - Time and Tide
programme.desc: S3E5 - At Kachelot Creek, Jared targets abandoned timber to add to a crucial payday; but there's a catch, he and Ross must load it themselves; can they beat the high tide or will they risk losing access, falling further behind in the Forever Claim race? (Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: Deadliest Catch - Wrong Side of the Law (New)
programme.desc: S22E7 - When Monte discovers Keith set pots in an illegal zone, he and the Wizard crew must pay the price in blood and treasure; a storm reconnects Jake to the larger-than-life hero of the Cornelia Marie's past; Johnathan gambles on a million-dollar fall season. (Reality, Documentary, Adventure)

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen - Taking on Water (New)
programme.desc: S2E14 - Disaster strikes the Forever Claim: a boom boat sinks as a winter storm is closing in; Jared must launch a risky recovery mission to raise it before the final log barge arrives, or he risks losing control of the claim. (Outdoors, Reality)

programme.desc: S1E11 - In the heart of Helsinki, chaos erupts; from blind foam crashes and flying salamis to a seatless DeLorean, Finland delivers fearless speed.

programme.title: Gold Rush - Moneyball
programme.desc: S14E17 - Parker closes in on his season goal, but an emergency leaves a novice crew in charge and threatens his momentum; Minnie forces Tony to consult a mining expert; dangerous conditions at Rally Valley could destroy Rick's fleet.

programme.title: Expedition Files - Smoke and Mirrors
programme.desc: S4E12 - Josh Gates explores how new evidence reshapes history's mysteries: a fresh analysis of Edgar Allan Poe's death; a novel take on Ponce de León's quest for the Fountain of Youth.

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures - Topwater Trout in Sarasota
programme.desc: S29E11 - Capt. Rick Murphy tosses topwater lures for trout in Sarasota with his longtime friend Capt. Geoff Page.

programme.title: Uncharted Waters With Peter Miller - Giant Tuna Fishing in Cape Cod Bay
programme.desc: S7E2 - Peter targets the largest bluefin tuna of his life off Cape Cod, MA. Trying to best 800 pounds, he's using live bluefish and butterfish chunks for bait -- and then witnesses a feeding frenzy of giant tuna and thresher shark with Captain Damon Sacco.

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures - Bull Reds on Parade in Venice
programme.desc: S29E12 - Capt. Rick Murphy is in Venice, LA, chasing bull redfish with Gregor Dornau and Erik Applegate from Star Brite.

programme.title: Uncharted Waters With Peter Miller - False Albacore Frenzy in Cape Cod
programme.desc: S7E3 - Peter targets false albacore, known as albies, up off Cape Cod with Capt. Jack and Robbie. They stop by The Port Restaurant for some epic food with Peter's old pal and restaurateur, Griffin Brackett.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue - Two Miles High and Dry
programme.desc: S14E2 - At over 9,000 feet, a Colorado family faces inhospitable alpine isolation; winter looms, threatening to cut them off from civilization; the Raneys must upgrade their infrastructure and water supply before it's too late.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue - Uphill Battle
programme.desc: S14E4 - The Raneys head to West Virginia to rescue a mountaintop homestead with over 300 animals and no water; but the land and its owners are stubbornly resisting the necessary changes, making the rescue one of their biggest challenges yet.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue - Help Me, Obi Wan Adobe
programme.desc: S14E6 - A young couple's dream adobe homestead in New Mexico is dying, smothered by invasive trees; the Raneys take on their first adobe home rescue.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Hunting Vampires
programme.desc: S2E4 - Josh explores the history of vampirism in Romania and Bulgaria.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Viking Secrets
programme.desc: S4E1 - From Denmark and Iceland to the United States and Canada, Josh Gates treads into Viking territory in an effort to unlock answers to their most enduring secrets, including how they attained and sustained their power and how far they really traveled.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Vikings In America
programme.desc: S4E2 - Josh traces the Vikings' westward expansion from the volcanic landscape of Iceland to a mysterious settlement in Greenland; he aims to find out if the Vikings landed in the United States more than 500 years before any other Europeans.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - The Hunt for the Golden Owl
programme.desc: S6E9 - Josh uses a book of riddles with cryptic clues and joins treasure hunters using new leads to find the Golden Owl statuette hidden somewhere in France.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Hunt for the Chupacabra
programme.desc: S7E7 - In Puerto Rico, Josh Gates explores caves and treks through dense jungles in search of the chupacabra; working with a wildlife biologist, a veterinarian and an investigator, Josh explores a recent wave of attacks to separate fact from fiction.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Return of the Yeti
programme.desc: Beginning in Kathmandu, Josh Gates heads high into the Himalayas of Nepal to obtain scientific evidence of the legendary Yeti; this time his mission is personal, and his search will take him into uncharted territory.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - The Monster and the Mountain
programme.desc: In part two of his hunt for the elusive Yeti, Josh Gates ascends higher into the Himalayas to explore caves, examine ancient artifacts and investigate the mystical ties the legendary creature holds with the Nepalese people.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Out of Thin Air
programme.desc: The hunt for the Yeti continues as Josh Gates' quest takes him from the frozen slopes of Mount Everest to the isolated forests of Bhutan, where Josh uses bait to force a more personal encounter with the creature. (Adventure, Documentary, History, Mystery, Travel)

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Unmasking the Myth
programme.desc: In the finale, Josh rafts into the remotest corners of Bhutan to capture some of his best evidence yet of the reclusive Yeti; he returns to the USA, where his samples are analyzed to answer the question, is the Yeti real? (Adventure, Documentary, History, Mystery, Travel)

programme.title: Gold Rush - Parker's New Toy
programme.desc: S14E18 - Parker brings in a brand-new wash plant to push him past 5,000 ounces; Buzz stands up to Rick and puts his reputation on the line with a gamble he may come to regret; disaster strikes on the McCaughans' night shift. (Reality, Adventure, Outdoors, Nature)

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part One (1930-1959)
programme.desc: Adolph Rupp comes to the University of Kentucky in 1930, two years before the SEC is formed, and his Wildcats go on to dominate play in the conference for decades. Meanwhile, a future coaching legend later known as Pat Summitt is born in Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part Two (1960-1970)
programme.desc: Texas Western's historic win over Adolph Rupp's Kentucky team in the 1966 NCAA final marks a turning point in the SEC. Vanderbilt's Perry Wallace becomes the conference's first Black player, while at LSU, Pete Maravich rewrites the record books.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part Three (1971-1979)
programme.desc: Dale Brown brings an infectious personality to LSU while Pat Summitt begins her legendary coaching career at Tennessee. And the year after Adolph Rupp's death in 1977, his successor Joe B. Hall leads Kentucky to its first NCAA title in 20 years.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part Four (1980-1989)
programme.desc: Georgia's Dominique Wilkins and Auburn's Charles Barkley headline the SEC's successes in the early 1980s, while LSU's Dale Brown takes two teams to the Final Four. Pat Summitt wins her first two national titles at Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part Five (1990-1998)
programme.desc: Arkansas joins the SEC and becomes one of the conference's top teams, led by fiery coach Nolan Richardson and his "40 Minutes of Hell" attack. Kentucky returns to prominence, and at Tennessee, Pat Summitt wins three straight NCAA titles.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part Six (1998-2010)
programme.desc: In his first year at Kentucky, Tubby Smith becomes the third Black coach ever to win a national title. Florida's back-to-back NCAA crowns mark the rise of a new power. The Lady Vols win 2 straight NCAA titles as LSU reaches 5 straight Final Fours.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball - Part Seven (2011-2022)
programme.desc: John Calipari continues the winning tradition at Kentucky with a national championship in 2012. Four years later, Pat Summitt passes away after battling early-onset Alzheimer's disease. Dawn Staley leads South Carolina to a pair of NCAA titles.

programme.title: 2 Days in the Valley
programme.desc: Dosmo Pizzo (Danny Aiello), an ordinary guy, finds himself involved in a murder-for-hire scheme. He is betrayed by his partner, the strangely serene Lee Woods (James Spader), who leaves him for dead. Suspecting that Woods will come back to finish him, Dosmo takes an obnoxious art dealer (Greg Cruttwell) and his sweet-natured assistant (Glenne Headly) hostage. Meanwhile, a rookie policeman (Eric Stoltz) investigating the murder begins to suspect that some kind of conspiracy is behind it. - Danny Aiello, Glenne Headly, Jeff Daniels, James Spader, Greg Cruttwell (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Here After
programme.desc: Claire is overjoyed when her daughter, Robin, is miraculously revived after a fatal accident. However, her relief soon turns to dread as she starts to suspect that something dark has followed Robin back from the brink of death. - Connie Britton, Freya Hannan-Mills, Giovanni Cirfiera, Syama Rayner, Andrea Bruschi (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: With the help of his defense lawyer (Kelly Lynch), who is madly in love with him, psychotic killer Michael Bosworth (Mickey Rourke) escapes prison and goes on the run with his brother (Elias Koteas) and his partner in crime (David Morse). Killing time before his lawyer can meet up with them, the three invade the home of Tim (Anthony Hopkins) and Nora Cornell (Mimi Rogers), a bickering couple on the brink of divorce. Now the couple must fight to save their marriage, and their lives. - Mickey Rourke, Anthony Hopkins, Mimi Rogers, Lindsay Crouse, Kelly Lynch (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Babysitter
programme.desc: Jennifer (Alicia Silverstone) is a lovely teen who has been hired to baby-sit the kids of Harry Tucker (J.T. Walsh) and his wife, Dolly (Lee Garlington). The Tuckers go to a party and proceed to get inebriated, with Mr. Tucker fantasizing about his beautiful babysitter. Meanwhile, Jack (Jeremy London), her boyfriend, and Mark (Nicky Katt), another guy interested in her, decide to spy on Jennifer at the Tucker house, with each young man also fixated on her. - Alicia Silverstone, Jeremy London, J.T. Walsh, Lee Garlington, Nicky Katt (Thriller)

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin, Woody Harrelson, Kelly Macdonald (Crime drama, Thriller, Western)

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: Jodie Foster stars as Clarice Starling, a top student at the FBI's training academy. Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out. - Jodie Foster, Anthony Hopkins, Scott Glenn, Ted Levine, Anthony Heald (Thriller, Crime drama)

Simpson (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure)

Jack jumps into the water and fishes out Sally (Nancy Allen) from the car, but the other passenger is already dead -- a governor intending to run for president. As Jack does some investigating of his tapes, and starts a perilous romance with Sally, he enters a tangled web of conspiracy that might leave him dead. - John Travolta, Nancy Allen, John Lithgow, Dennis Franz, Peter Boyden (Thriller, Mystery)

When Nang sees social worker Chandler Jarrell (Eddie Murphy) on television discussing his ability to find missing children, she solicits his expertise, despite his skepticism over being "chosen." - Eddie Murphy, Charles Dance, Charlotte Lewis, Victor Wong, Randall "Tex" Cobb (Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: My Left Foot

Though Christy is a spastic quadriplegic and essentially paralyzed, a miraculous event occurs when, at the age of 5, he demonstrates control of his left foot by using chalk to scrawl a word on the floor. With the help of his steely mother (Brenda Fricker) -- and no shortage of grit and determination -- Christy overcomes his infirmity to become a painter, poet and author. - Daniel Day-Lewis, Ray McAnally, Brenda Fricker, Ruth McCabe, Fiona Shaw (Biography)

Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives. - Dustin Hoffman, Tom Cruise, Valeria Golino, Jerry Molen, Jack Murdock (Drama)

Aided by his loyal friend Ray Templeton, Vaughn tries to make a stand against the area's crime and corruption, but, finding no help from the police, he must take matters into his own hands. - The Rock, Johnny Knoxville, Neal McDonough, Kristen Wilson, Ashley Scott (Action)

Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands. - Ben Affleck, Aaron Eckhart, Uma Thurman, Paul Giamatti, Colm Feore (Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." programme.title: Love, Simon
programme.desc: Everyone deserves a great love story, but for 17-year-old Simon Spier, it's a little more complicated. He hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing. - Nick Robinson, Josh Duhamel, Jennifer Garner, Tony Hale, Katherine Langford (Romantic comedy, Drama, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Lady Bird
programme.desc: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. - Saoirse Ronan, Laurie Metcalf, Timothée Chalamet, Lucas Hedges, Tracy Letts (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time. - Anna Kendrick, Hailee Steinfeld, Rebel Wilson, John Lithgow, Elizabeth Banks (Musical comedy, Comedy)

programme.title: Red Sparrow
programme.desc: Prima ballerina Dominika Egorova faces a bleak and uncertain future after she suffers an injury that ends her career. She soon turns to Sparrow School, a secret intelligence service that trains exceptional young people to use their minds and bodies as weapons. Egorova emerges as the most dangerous Sparrow after completing the sadistic training process. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust. - Jennifer Lawrence, Joel Edgerton, Charlotte Rampling, Matthias Schoenaerts, Mary-Louise Parker (Thriller, Action, Drama)

programme.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
programme.desc: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy. - Colin Firth, Julianne Moore, Taron Egerton, Mark Strong, Halle Berry (Action, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: Catfish
programme.desc: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. - Wendy Whelan, Tiler Peck, Drew Jacoby, Blake Alexandros (Documentary, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: A Boston bank robber (Ben Affleck) looks for a way out of his criminal lifestyle after beginning a passionate romance with the woman (Rebecca Hall) that his gang briefly took hostage.

programme.title: All Eyez on Me
programme.desc: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices.

programme.title: Everything, Everything
programme.desc: Confined to her house due to an illness, a smart and imaginative 18-year-old (Amandla Stenberg) develops a budding romance with the teen (Nick Robinson) who lives next door.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: A man wages a legal battle against his mother for custody of his orphaned niece, a young mathematics prodigy who wants to live with him.

programme.title: Patti Cake$
programme.desc: Patricia, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back.

programme.title: They All Laughed
programme.desc: New York private eyes (Ben Gazzara, John Ritter) fall for wives they've been hired by husbands to follow.

programme.title: Look Into My Eyes
programme.desc: A group of New York City psychics conducts deeply intimate readings for their clients, revealing a kaleidoscope of loneliness, connection and healing.

programme.title: A Different Man
programme.desc: Aspiring actor Edward undergoes a radical medical procedure to drastically transform his appearance. But his new dream face turns into a nightmare as he becomes obsessed with reclaiming what he lost.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

programme.title: Red Riding Hood
programme.desc: A young woman (Amanda Seyfried) begins to suspect that the werewolf terrorizing her village is someone she loves.

programme.title: Sucker Punch
programme.desc: Retreating into a fantasy world, a captive young woman (Emily Browning) finds four allies to join in a fight to escape from the terrible fate that awaits them.

programme.title: Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets
programme.desc: In the 28th century, two special operatives (Dane DeHaan, Cara Delevingne) race against time to save the diverse city of Alpha from a dark force that also jeopardizes the future of the universe.

programme.title: Blue Beetle
programme.desc: Jaime Reyes finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with a suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels. - Tyler Perry, Matthew Fox, Edward Burns, Rachel Nichols, Jean Reno (Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly pregnant Belinda after her mother-in-law moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere. - Brandy, Andrew Burnap, Kathryn Hunter, Neal Huff, Morgen McKynzie (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless. Still, the production strains the couple's marriage. - Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren, Scarlett Johansson, Toni Collette, Danny Huston (Historical drama, Biography)

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Now that Chris and his girlfriend, Rose, have reached the meet-the-parents milestone of dating, she invites him for a weekend getaway with Missy and Dean. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries leads him to a truth that he never could have imagined. - Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Catherine Keener, Bradley Whitford, Caleb Landry Jones (Horror, Thriller, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. - Jessica Rothe, Israel Broussard, Ruby Modine, Rachel Matthews, Charles Aitken (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Final Destination
programme.desc: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. - Devon Sawa, Ali Larter, Kerr Smith, Kristen Cloke, Daniel Roebuck (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Final Destination 2
programme.desc: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. - Ali Larter, A.J. Cook, Michael Landes, Terrence "T.C." Carson, Jonathan Cherry (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Final Destination 3
programme.desc: Six years after a group of high-school students first cheated death, another teen (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) has a premonition that she and her friends will be involved in a horrifying roller-coaster accident. When the vision proves true, the student and her fellow survivors must deal with the repercussions of cheating the Grim Reaper. - Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Ryan Merriman, Kris Lemche, Texas Battle, Alexz Johnson (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Final Destination 5
programme.desc: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied. - Nicholas D'Agosto, Emma Bell, Miles Fisher, Ellen Wroe, Jacqueline MacInnes-Wood (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Final Destination
programme.desc: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate. - Bobby Campo, Shantel VanSanten, Nick Zano, Haley Webb, Mykelti Williamson (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
programme.desc: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. - Kevin Costner, Sienna Miller, Sam Worthington, Giovanni Ribisi, Abbey Lee (Western, Drama)

programme.title: The House
programme.desc: Scott and Kate Johansen must figure out a way to earn some money after their daughter's scholarship falls through. When all else fails, the desperate couple join forces with their neighbor Frank to start an underground casino in his home. As the cash rolls in and the good times fly, Scott and Kate soon learn that they may have bitten off more than they can chew. - Will Ferrell, Amy Poehler, Jason Mantzoukas, Ryan Simpkins, Nick Kroll (Comedy)

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: In this dark comedy, the crotchety Willie T. Stokes (Billy Bob Thornton) and his partner (Tony Cox) reunite once a year for a holiday con. Posing as a mall Santa and his elf, they rip off shopping outlets on Christmas Eve. This year, however, Willie is falling apart. He's depressed and alcoholic, and his erratic behavior draws the suspicion of mall security (Bernie Mac). But when befriending a small boy brings out his kinder side, Willie begins to wonder if there is still some hope for him. - Billy Bob Thornton, Tony Cox, Brett Kelly, Lauren Graham, Lauren Tom (Holiday, Dark comedy, Crime drama)

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior. - Billy Bob Thornton, Kathy Bates, Tony Cox, Christina Hendricks, Brett Kelly (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: In a series of interconnected stories, various Los Angeles residents (Jessica Alba, Jessica Biel, Bradley Cooper) wend their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day. As the holiday unfolds, they experience first dates, longtime commitments, youthful crushes and connections to old flames. - Jessica Alba, Kathy Bates, Jessica Biel, Bradley Cooper, Eric Dane (Holiday, Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Due Date
programme.desc: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. - Robert Downey Jr., Zach Galifianakis, Michelle Monaghan, Jamie Foxx, Juliette Lewis (Dark comedy, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. - Jessica Lange, Ed Harris, Ann Wedgeworth, David Clennon, James Staley (Biography)

programme.title: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. - Billy Crystal, Bette Midler, Marisa Tomei, Tom Everett Scott, Bailee Madison (Children, Comedy)

James Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the USS Enterprise are carrying Klingon Chancellor Gorkon (David Warner) to Earth to negotiate a peace treaty with the United Federation of Planets. programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: A New York reporter heads to Australia to interview the living legend Mike Dundee (Paul Hogan). When she finally locates him, she is so taken with him that she brings him back with her to New York. In New York, Mike Dundee is amazed by the wonders of the city and the interesting people there. - Paul Hogan, Linda Kozlowski, Mark Blum, John Meillon, David Gulpilil (Comedy)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Adventures of Sharkboy and Lavagirl
programme.desc: Bullied by classmates, young Max escapes into a fantasy, conjuring up the action-packed lives of Lavagirl and Sharkboy. But one day, Lavagirl and Sharkboy suddenly come to life -- and their world, Planet Drool, needs a hero named Max. As Max escapes to Planet Drool, he battles aliens and tries to save his new friends' planet from destruction. He also battles his bullies, who have become villains like the Ice Princess. - Taylor Lautner, Taylor Dooley, Cayden Boyd, George Lopez, David Arquette (Children, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Spy Kids
programme.desc: Two young kids become spies in attempt to save their parents, who are ex-spies, from an evil mastermind. Armed with a bag of high-tech gadgets and out-of-this world transportation, Carmen and Juni will bravely jet through the air, dive under the seas and crisscross the globe in a series of thrilling adventures on a mission to save their parents ... and maybe even the world. - Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa Vega, Daryl Sabara, Alan Cumming (Family, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams
programme.desc: Now full-fledged Spy Kids, Carmen (Alexa Vega) and Juni (Daryl Sabara) Cortez are back for another James Bond-style adventure. Their newest mission takes them to a distant island where they take on a mysterious man and his imaginative creatures. But this time, they also have to fight the forces of rival sibling Spy Kids, Gary (Matt O'Leary) and Gerti (Emily Osment) Giggles, as they head right into a trap that will test each and every spy in the Cortez family. - Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa Vega, Daryl Sabara, Steve Buscemi (Family, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over
programme.desc: A boy tries to rescue his sister (Alexa Vega) inside a virtual-reality game created by a madman out to enslave children.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Downhill Racer
programme.desc: A cocky American skis and après-skis Europe, training with his coach for the Olympics.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise encounter sabotage on the way to peace talks with the Klingon Federation.

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: A high school senior (Lucas Till) befriends a strange subterranean creature after building a monster truck from bits and pieces of scrapped cars.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A being with the ability to manipulate the four elements joins forces with a waterbender and her brother to restore balance to their war-torn world.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: A species of creatures known as thoriphants rebel against their life of servitude and embark on a journey to find the fabled city of Uprights.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher moonlights as a mixed martial arts fighter to raise money to save his school's music program.

programme.title: Uncle Buck
programme.desc: A bumbling relative gets the chance to redeem himself when he's called upon to look after his brother's three children.

programme.title: Young Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Victorian London schoolboys Holmes (Nicholas Rowe) and Watson (Alan Cox) become friends while in pursuit of a lethal pagan cult.

programme.title: The Hundred-Foot Journey
programme.desc: A haughty French restaurateur (Helen Mirren) objects to a nearby Indian eatery until she tastes food made by the chef (Manish Dayal) and recognizes his remarkable ability to create delicious dishes.

programme.title: Hotel for Dogs
programme.desc: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings (Emma Roberts, Jake T. Austin) transform an abandoned hotel into a home for their pooch and a slew of stray dogs.

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Buddy (Will Ferrell) was accidentally transported to the North Pole as a toddler and raised to adulthood among Santa's elves. Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results. - Will Ferrell, James Caan, Bob Newhart, Edward Asner, Mary Steenburgen (Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive. - Helen Mirren, Katie Holmes, Jeffrey Tambor, Barry Watson, Marisa Coughlan (Comedy)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Conor (Keanu Reeves) is a ticket scalper, gambler and, now, Little League coach for a rag-tag team of kids in one of the toughest part of Chicago. He's no role model, but his buddy Jimmy won't help him pay off his gambling debts unless Conor coaches Jimmy's corporately sponsored team. Surprising even himself, Conor becomes attached to his players -- and to their attractive schoolteacher (Diane Lane) -- and drawn into their tough and sometimes tragic lives. - Keanu Reeves, Diane Lane, John Hawkes, Bryan C. Hearne, Julian Griffith (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: The Hundred-Foot Journey
programme.desc: Hassan Kadam is an extraordinarily talented and largely self-taught culinary novice. When he and his family are displaced from their native India and settle in a quaint French village, they decide to open an Indian eatery. However, Madame Mallory, the proprietress of an acclaimed restaurant just 100 feet away, strongly objects. War erupts between the two establishments, until Mallory recognizes Kadam's impressive epicurean gifts and takes him under her wing. - Helen Mirren, Om Puri, Manish Dayal, Charlotte Le Bon, Amit Shah (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Ignacio (Jack Black), or Nacho to his friends, works as a cook in the Mexican monastery where he grew up. The monastery is home to a host of orphans whom Nacho cares for deeply, but there is not much money to feed them properly. Nacho decides to raise money for the children by moonlighting as a Lucha Libre wrestler with his partner Esqueleto (Héctor Jiménez), but since the church forbids Lucha, Nacho must disguise his identity. - Jack Black, Ana de la Reguera, Héctor Jiménez, Richard Montoya, Peter Stormare (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Dreamer: Inspired by a True Story
programme.desc: Ben Crane (Kurt Russell) is a horse trainer who is struggling to connect with his precocious daughter, Cale (Dakota Fanning). But then a horse by the name of Soñador suffers a broken leg after its evil owner (David Morse) races her despite Ben's advice. Rather than put his client's injured horse down, Ben adopts her and welcomes Cale into the family business. They train Soñador to race again as grouchy but kind-hearted Grandpa (Kris Kristofferson) lends his encouragement. - Kurt Russell, Dakota Fanning, Kris Kristofferson, Elisabeth Shue, David Morse (Children, Drama)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons. - William Shatner, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. - Matthew McConaughey, Steve Zahn, Penélope Cruz, Lambert Wilson, Glynn Turman (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Cabbie-turned-chauffeur Jimmy Tong (Jackie Chan) learns there is really only one rule when you work for playboy millionaire Clark Devlin (Jason Isaacs) : Never touch Devlin's prized tuxedo. But when Devlin is temporarily put out of commission in an explosive accident, Jimmy puts on the tux and soon discovers that this extraordinary suit may be more black belt than black tie. Paired with a partner (Jennifer Love Hewitt) as inexperienced as he is, Jimmy becomes an unwitting secret agent. - Jackie Chan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Jason Isaacs, Debi Mazar, Ritchie Coster (Comedy, Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Thriller)

programme.title: Mirror Mirror
programme.desc: Snow White (Lily Collins), an orphaned princess, is the rightful ruler of her kingdom, but a jealous, evil queen (Julia Roberts) schemes to gain control. When a charming prince (Armie Hammer) spurns the queen in favor of Snow White, she has the princess thrown into the woods to be devoured by a fearsome beast. Rescued by a band of diminutive highway robbers, Snow White vows to take back her realm from the treacherous queen and, with the help of her small rescuers, roars into action. - Julia Roberts, Lily Collins, Armie Hammer, Nathan Lane, Mare Winningham (Children, Fantasy, Comedy, Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. - Robert Redford, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Lopez, Becca Gardner, Josh Lucas (Drama)

programme.title: Ollie's Pack - Ollie in the House; The Ollie Files

programme.title: Piñata Smashlings - Jet's B Team

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series - Exit Sandman; Roadkill Trip
programme.desc: S1E19 - The Sandman puts the hotel under a spell; Mavis and Uncle Gene go on one last road trip. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Action)

programme.title: Best & Bester - Mugshot; Taken to the Cleaners
programme.desc: S1E15 - Best is mistaken for a notorious jewel thief; Best and Bester go on an undercover mission to find out why items of laundry are going missing. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.desc: S2E13 - Scooby and the gang go on the set of an in-progress Jekyll and Hyde movie remake with actress Sandy Duncan. (Animated, Children, Mystery, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Finale

programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Enraged to discover that humans have been stealing their honey goodness, Barry sets out on a crusade that will change the ecosystem forever. Will it be for the better? A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: Two fathers get laid off from their well-paid jobs and are forced to stay at home to look after their kids. Seeing the opportunity to make money, the two of them open their own day-care centre. programme.title: Minions

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.

programme.title: Tim Burton's Corpse Bride
programme.desc: Anxious not to make a mistake in his wedding ceremony, Victor goes to the woods to practise his vows. Unfortunately, he slides the ring onto the twig finger of a long-dead bride who has been waiting years for a suitor.

Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. programme.desc: Cricket - International,Sports · England v New Zealand. Coverage of day three of the Second Test in the three-match series, held at The Kia Oval in London. programme.title: Live US Open Golf · 2026 US Open Golf Day 2
programme.desc: Golf,Sports · Coverage of day two of the 126th staging of the Major, held this year at Shinnecock Hills Golf Club in Southampton, New York. American JJ Spaun won this event last year after he finished on one-under-par, two strokes ahead of nearest challenger Robert MacIntyre. Spaun became the third consecutive golfer from the United States to win the tournament, and the ninth American in 11 years to win the title since 2015. Other winners include Jordan Spieth, Bryson DeChambeau, Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka, who won back-to-back titles in 2017 and 2018.

Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. programme.title: College Football - Vanderbilt at Alabama
programme.desc: The No. 16 Commodores (5-0, 1-0 SEC) vie for their first win streak against the No. 10 Crimson Tide (3-1, 1-0) since 1956. Vanderbilt snapped a 23-game series slide with a 40-35 victory in 2024. Alabama won at then-No. 5 Georgia 24-21 in Week 5. (Football)

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoun (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Canton (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy). - Eddie Murphy, Richard Pryor, Redd Foxx, Danny Aiello, Michael Lerner (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Literature professor Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) leads a secret life as a high-stakes gambler. Always a risk-taker, Bennett bets it all when he borrows from a gangster and offers his own life as collateral. Staying one step ahead, he pits his creditor against the operator of an illicit gambling ring while garnering the attention of Frank (John Goodman), a paternalistic loan shark. As his relationship with a student (Brie Larson) deepens, Bennett must risk everything for a second chance. - Mark Wahlberg, John Goodman, Brie Larson, Michael Kenneth Williams, Jessica Lange (Crime drama)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: 21 Jump Street

But, as time goes on, Schmidt and Jenko discover that high school is nothing like it was just a few years earlier -- and, what's more, they must again confront the teenage terror and anxiety they thought they had left behind. - Jonah Hill, Channing Tatum, Brie Larson, Dave Franco, Rob Riggle (Comedy, Action)

programme.title: 22 Jump Street

When Jenko meets a kindred spirit on the football team and Schmidt infiltrates the bohemian art-major scene, both men begin to question their partnership. Not only do they have to crack the case, but now the two overgrown adolescents must learn how to behave like adults. - Jonah Hill, Channing Tatum, Peter Stormare, Wyatt Russell, Amber Stevens (Comedy, Action)

Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin, Woody Harrelson, Kelly Macdonald (Crime drama, Thriller, Western)

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Kate Beckinsale, John C. Reilly, Alec Baldwin (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey, Emma Thompson, Shirley Henderson (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: Kate McKay (Meg Ryan) is a modern day executive, a 21st century woman driven to succeed in the corporate world. Leopold, the third Duke of Albany, is a charming gent and bachelor of the late 18OOs. With career and social expectations looming, each has grown cynical about the very notion of falling in love. But when a rip in the fabric of time thrusts Leopold into present day New York, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites. - Meg Ryan, Hugh Jackman, Liev Schreiber, Breckin Meyer, Natasha Lyonne (Romantic comedy, Fantasy)

Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. - Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer, Ben Affleck, Marton Csokas (Historical drama)

Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell). - John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe, James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, Leslie Stefanson (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.desc: S1E16 - The daughter of a wealthy family is kidnapped in an attempt to gain notorious internet fame; Maggie and OA discover the kidnapper's plans go far beyond abduction.

programme.title: FBI - Apex
programme.desc: S1E17 - Maggie and Dana struggle to find justice for victims murdered by a serial killer; the mayor limits the investigation to cut costs.

programme.title: FBI - Most Wanted
programme.desc: S1E18 - OA and Maggie team up with members of the FBI's Fugitives Department to track down a person wanted for murder who is also on America's Top 10 Most Wanted list.

programme.title: FBI - Conflict of Interest
programme.desc: S1E19 - The team must take down a dangerous drug ring after an American diplomat is killed while being used as a pawn; Jubal and OA try to help friends from their past fight off their inner demons.

programme.title: FBI - Little Egypt
programme.desc: S2E1 - After a bomb detonates at a restaurant in Queens, the case becomes personal for OA, who grew up eating there; OA goes undercover to prevent another incident.

programme.title: FBI - The Lives of Others
programme.desc: S2E2 - After the son of a prominent blogger is kidnapped, the team must sweep through her two million followers to find the culprit; Kristen continues to adjust to life as a field agent with her new partner Stuart Scola.

programme.title: FBI - American Idol
programme.desc: S2E3 - After a female presidential candidate, Valerie Caldwell, is targeted with a car bomb, OA and Maggie must find them before they strike again; the case leads them to wonder if she is being targeted for her political aspirations or something else.

programme.title: FBI - An Imperfect Science
programme.desc: S2E4 - After a shooting at a nightclub, it appears that the FBI may have ignored previous threats from a local white supremacist group; Kristen wrestles with her commitment to the bureau and her responsibility to her community.

programme.title: FBI - Crossroads
programme.desc: S2E5 - A loving husband and father of two is kidnapped after accidentally getting involved in illegal dealings far beyond what he imagined; Jubal must make a difficult decision regarding his family and their future.

programme.title: FBI - Outsider
programme.desc: S2E6 - After a Wall Street investor is murdered, the team is led to an insider-trading ring that uses unconventional methods to gain information; OA struggles to maintain confidence in his budding relationship with Mona.

programme.title: FBI - Undisclosed
programme.desc: S2E7 - When a board member of a soon-to-be-public medical tech company is murdered, the team tries to find out who had the most to gain from his death; OA is conflicted when pressure to help a family member is at odds with his commitment to tell the truth.

programme.title: FBI - Codename: Ferdinand
programme.desc: S2E8 - A car crash results in the death of a photographer; Maggie sympathizes with his widow when she notices similarities with her own husband's death.

programme.title: FBI - Salvation
programme.desc: S2E9 - After an altercation with a student, teacher Patrick Miller goes missing, leading the team to investigate everyone who might have had a grudge against him; a key witness in the case steps up to help.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: Fearsome monsters Godzilla and Kong square off in an epic battle for the ages. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet.

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: Superstar Will Smith stars in this futuristic action-adventure about a techno-phobic police detective who teams up with a humanoid robot to thwart a worldwide revolution.

programme.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision (Live)
programme.desc: S4E27 - Athena battles Maya World for a spot in the finals of the Owen Hart Foundation Women's Tournament; The Young Bucks and Jack Perry join forces to take on The Lethal Twist. Plus, NJPW technical wizard Zack Sabre Jr. goes one-on-one against Adam Priest.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. - Rebecca Hall, Brian Tyree Henry, Dan Stevens, Kaylee Hottle, Alex Ferns (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee. - Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: FBI - What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: S1E20 - When a controversial senior leader from Egypt comes to New York for a heart transplant, OA struggles to balance his personal opinion with his professional duty when he is assigned to the security detail. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Sela Ward (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Appearances
programme.desc: S1E21 - After a decorated FBI agent is murdered, the team investigates and learns that the man led a double life; Maggie struggles with what information she should reveal to the agent's widow, who is also her personal friend. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Sela Ward (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Ties That Bind
programme.desc: S2E10 - A former kidnapping victim is linked to a series of murders that includes the daughter of an NYPD detective; Kristen begins to doubt her ability as an agent after a training exercise leaves her shaken. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Fallout
programme.desc: S2E11 - After a businessman with a history of harassment claims against him is killed, the team suspects the killer may be one of his many accusers. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Hard Decisions
programme.desc: S2E12 - A bank holdup leads the team to a safe deposit box, the contents of which have the potential to destroy national security; Kristen is eager to get back into field work while other team members still have their concerns. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Payback
programme.desc: S2E13 - The son of a retired FBI agent is kidnapped, and the team must investigate if it's an act of revenge; Isobel must make a hard call when information from the past comes to light. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Studio Gangster
programme.desc: S2E14 - When an attorney is found dead near the body of a private escort, the team must piece together what connected the two seemingly random victims; Jubal's connection with one of the victims makes finding the killer much more personal. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Legacy
programme.desc: S2E15 - After a truck filled with armor-piercing rifles is hijacked, the team works to discover who stole it, and what they have planned for the stolen weapons; a friend from OA's past returns to help with the case, but OA isn't sure he can trust him. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Safe Room
programme.desc: S2E16 - After the police ignore a desperate father's plea for help, he abducts a billionaire's daughter and holds her hostage in a safe room until his own missing child is returned to him; Jubal puts his hostage negotiation skills to the test. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Ebonée Noel, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)
